verdict.rationale: Founder Law is an immigration and startup law firm. A buyer could fairly ask whether its client experience includes a structured evidence-collection portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents checklists, document uploads, reminders or a client portal. The only workflow-like item is a short case-assessment intake form, which is adjacent and does not cover evidence collection.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments
